🎓 Moodle Teacher Guide

Instruction for question creators and instructors

🎓
This version of the editor is integrated directly into Moodle's quiz activity for building question models and previewing assignments.
For Teachers — Creating a Question
  1. Add a Syntax Tree Question in your Moodle course.
  2. Build your tree using the node controls (↑ and ↓), starting from the ? node, or paste bracket notation into the top toolbar.
  3. The tree you build in the editor will be the starting state for students.
  4. Alternative Labels: Use the | symbol (e.g., S|IP) to allow multiple correct labels for a node.
Advanced Configuration
  • ⚙️
    Checkboxes:
    • Allow Import: Lets students import their own bracket notation.
    • Case-sensitive labels: Node labels must match in upper and lower case, so vP and VP count as different. Off by default. Syntactic functions are always compared case-insensitively.
    • Show Functions: Activates the Syntactic Functions Window above the tree.
  • 📊
    Grading Weights: Set the percentage of the grade coming from the Tree Structure (e.g., 70%). The remainder (30%) will automatically be assigned to the Functions Window scoring.
  • 📝
    Functions List: Define the required syntactic functions using the specific format: Phrase | Function=100; Alternative=50
    Example: dog | direct object=100; object=50
Teacher Features
  • Import Bracket
    Builds a visual tree from the bracket text provided in the input field.
  • Export Bracket
    Copy your tree as bracket notation to your template.
  • Clear Screen
    Resets the editor state completely for the starting condition.
Editing Features
  • ✏️
    Rename: Double-click (or long press) any node to edit its label. For leaves, you can also edit the word.
  • ↑
    Add Parent: Select a node and click the up arrow to insert a node above it.
  • ↓
    Add Child: Select a node and click the down arrow to add a node below it.
  • ✕
    Delete: Click the red X to remove a node. You can choose to keep or delete its children.
Navigation & Control
  • 🖐
    Pan/Zoom: Drag the background to move. Use buttons or pinch to zoom on touch screens.
  • 🔍
    Navigation Panel (Bottom-Right):
    • / to Undo / Redo.
    • + / - to Zoom.
    • 1:1 to Reset scale.
    • ⌖ to Center (or double-click background).
  • ⌨
    Shortcuts: Ctrl + Scroll (Zoom at cursor), Ctrl+Z (Undo), Ctrl+Y (Redo), Ctrl+0 (Reset).
  • ↕
    Collapse UI: Click the ▲ or ▼ toggle in the top-right corner to hide/show toolbars for more drawing space.
  • 🔵
    Edge Scrolling: Drag a node to the screen edge to auto-scroll the view.
